note: The surface-class manifest (S05 P5, design E2). Classifies every exports-map entry except the mechanical ./package.json. Ships in the tarball beside README.md; enforced by script/check-sdk-surface-labels.mjs. frozen entries carry no in-source marker by design: their classification lives here alone so the frozen sources stay untouched.

..reason: Classic's root convenience surface — EditorCore, utils, wasm media-time helpers and default constants; provider machinery throughout (measured at 0.2.0: no frozen-classified symbol flows through this barrel, so no symbol override is needed).

./surface.reason: The embeddable Surface — the S03+S04 embedding contract; surface/embedding/types.ts is one of the four byte-identical frozen surfaces the close-out control re-proves.

./surface.css.reason: The Surface's stylesheet — ships with the S04-frozen embeddable Surface and changes only additively with it (S04's surface-css freeze).

./session.reason: Session composition — Classic's own machinery, not contract surface.

./runtime.reason: Runtime composition (session-core-owner, session-stores) — Classic's own machinery.

./browser.reason: Browser runtime ports and C4 project load — Classic's own browser machinery.

./storage.reason: The storage barrel (react entry included) — Classic's own machinery.

./storage/conformance.reason: Classic's storage conformance harnesses — Classic's own machinery (adjudicated provider, not experimental: it is the provider's own published test rig).

./storage/migrations.reason: The react-free migration chain (runner, 31 transformers, CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION) — Classic's own machinery; carries the known wasm-init constraint stated in this package's README as policy truth.

./transactions.reason: The editor-native transaction plane (adapter + host seed + envelope reader) - Classic's own machinery, react-free and wasm-free by construction; the dual-plane unification's declared seam (ruled 2026-08-17).

./media.reason: Media helpers — Classic's own machinery (declared at extraction, currently unconsumed outside the package).

./fonts.reason: Font assets and helpers — Classic's own machinery.

./ui.reason: The design-system UI atoms — Classic's own machinery.

./evidence.reason: The surface-evidence harnesses — evidence/test infrastructure, unstable by intent (may change or be removed as evidence needs evolve).

./evidence/headless.reason: The headless graph harness — evidence/test infrastructure, unstable by intent.

./evidence/headless-semantic-fixture.reason: A narrow fixture for headless semantic verification — E1's named example of an explicitly-unstable narrow fixture.

./evidence/wasm-test-mock.reason: The wasm test-mock entry — test infrastructure (today the only working wasm init path for plain TS consumers; see the README's migration-surface constraint).
